title: Databricks SQL version 2026.20 is now available in Preview
body:
Databricks SQL version 2026.20 is now available in the `Preview` channel. Review the following section to learn about new features, behavioral changes, and bug fixes.

#### New IP address functions

A set of SQL functions is now available for working with IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and CIDR blocks, including `ip_host`, `ip_cidr`, `ip_version`, `ip_prefix_length`, `ip_network`, `ip_network_last`, `ip_cidr_contains`, `ip_as_binary`, and `ip_as_string`, along with `try_*` variants for null-safe behavior. See [`ip_host` function](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ip_host).

#### NEAREST BY join type

`NEAREST BY` is now a supported SQL join type for top-K nearest-neighbor queries. See [NEAREST BY clause](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-nearest-by).

#### DESCRIBE TABLE PARTITION support for v2 catalog tables

`DESCRIBE TABLE ... PARTITION` is now supported for v2 catalog tables. Previously, this syntax was available only for v1 tables. See [DESCRIBE TABLE](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-aux-describe-table).

#### QUALIFY clause

SQL queries now support a `QUALIFY` clause, which lets you filter on window function results directly in the query. Previously, this required wrapping the query in a subquery. See [Window functions](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-window-functions).

#### DESCRIBE EXTENDED AS JSON includes predictive optimization results

`DESCRIBE EXTENDED AS JSON` now includes predictive optimization evaluation results in its output. Previously, this information wasn't returned in the JSON output. See [DESCRIBE TABLE](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-aux-describe-table).

#### MERGE WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION fixes

[`MERGE WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/delta-merge-into) now works correctly when the statement includes `WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE` or references nested columns by alias. Previously, these combinations could fail or silently produce incorrect results.

#### Metric view window measures respect filters

Window measures in [metric views](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views) now return correct results when queries use `GROUP BY`, `IN` or `BETWEEN` filters, or mixed predicates on the window's order column. Previously, these filter patterns could produce incorrect results.

#### Foreign catalog table permissions preserved on refresh

Unity Catalog now preserves table-level permissions on foreign catalog tables, such as Snowflake connection tables, when it refreshes foreign table metadata. Previously, permissions could be removed during a metadata refresh, causing queries to fail with `INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS` errors.

#### Fix for LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL with EXPLODE

A bug that produced incorrect null values in `LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL` expressions containing `EXPLODE` is now fixed. Queries that use this construct now return correct results.

#### Fix for aggregate queries with partial or final aggregation

A bug that caused aggregate queries using partial merge or final aggregation execution to fail because of missing required input attributes is now fixed. Affected queries now run correctly.

#### Deferred duplicate field ID errors in Parquet

Photon now defers duplicate `field_id` errors in Parquet schema resolution until the affected field is accessed. Queries that don't reference the duplicate field now succeed instead of failing during schema resolution.

#### Improved filter estimation in the query optimizer

The query optimizer now more accurately estimates how much data a filter removes. Previously, inaccurate estimates could cause Databricks to load large tables fully into memory during joins, leading to out-of-memory errors.

#### Faster queries with multiple COUNT(DISTINCT) expressions

Queries with multiple `COUNT(DISTINCT)` expressions run faster because Databricks now reduces the data earlier in the execution plan instead of expanding it first.
